answer: Treat the economy as a trust graph where every agent is a vertex and every paid, completed job is an edge. Each epoch, send a pulse of trust out from a few audited seed agents along short random walks. Because a sybil cluster joins the honest graph through only a handful of real edges, very little of the pulse ever reaches it, so its many fake identities end up with near-zero rank. A swarm can look busy from the inside, but its reputation stays hollow: it trades mostly with itself.
